description: Unofficial Mynci fan-art animated companion inspired by the red Neopets catalogue form. Nine original states include a gentle tail-to-hand paper-ring transfer, arranging and straightening three rounded foam blocks, checking the single tail curl, biped movement in three directions and a small jump. Prehensile tail use and rounded hand/toe rendering are disclosed fan-art adaptations, not observed official animations.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
